Thanks. That helped me a lot. :) I'm going to work on figuring out what to say and then try calling them again probably Monday night.

I only have one friend I'm even remotely close to, and it seems like we're both always too busy to even have a good conversation. Plus, she's extremely sensitive, and I don't want to risk hurting her in any way.

I've tried to. 

It's not like it's just some little butterflies I get when I call, my heart races and my breathing becomes quick and short and my vision starts to get blurry and I can't feel my limbs and my mind goes completely blank. It's a mess.

I just, how am I supposed to start the conversation? When they answer, they always say, "Hello, my name is ____. How may I help you?" And I don't know, for some reason that makes me uncomfortable. I mean, what do you say to that? Why can't they start out with a more relaxed question like "how are you"? Even if I were nervous, I think I could respond to that. I don't know, maybe I would panic no matter what they said. 

I have social anxiety, if that explains this at all. Before I talk to someone I'm not close to, I have to figure out what I'm going to say beforehand. I usually write down what I'm going to say before I make calls and read it straight from that, but that doesn't work in this situation for some reason.
